🧠 AI Proof Gets A Physics Check An OpenAI model solved part of another $1 million Millennium Prize problem. Physicists confirmed its proof related to Yang-Mills quantum theory, which underpins the Standard Model. The theory predicts collider results accurately, but its mathematical consistency has remained unproven for more than 50 years. The hardest part is still unsolved, and the reasoning is not fully understood. ✔️ Proof code published November 10 ✔️ Work concerns Yang-Mills quantum theory ✔️ Physicists confirmed the proof ✔️ Model helps verify its own solution 👉 Github 👈 The code enables examination of the result, though checking the full reasoning remains difficult. 💻 @program

🟠 Cloudflare’s Open-Source Browser For AI Agents Cloudflare made Kitesurf free and fully open source. Built in Rust, it reportedly uses seven times less memory than Chrome and other Chromium-based browsers, along with nearly four times less CPU. It is designed for AI agents rather than regular browsing, with only the page tools needed to extract data. ✔️ Opens pages, applies styles, runs JavaScript, and takes screenshots ✔️ Works without tabs, themes, or extensions ✔️ Connects through Puppeteer, Playwright, and any MCP client ✔️ Available as a free project on GitHub 👉 Github 👈 Useful for testing lightweight browser automation and AI agent workflows. 💻 @program
